serve_flags: addr=:8080 | address the HTTP server listens on (env GOLDENAPP_ADDR)
admin-sub= | OIDC sub (not email) of the user to bootstrap as the global Admin; empty to skip (env GOLDENAPP_ADMIN_SUB)
database-dsn= | Postgres connection string; empty to run without a database (env GOLDENAPP_DATABASE_DSN)
google-client-id= | Google OAuth client ID; empty to disable sign-in (env GOLDENAPP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)
google-redirect-uri= | absolute Google OAuth callback URI registered with the client (env GOLDENAPP_GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI)
log-level=info | log level: debug, info, warn or error (env GOLDENAPP_LOG_LEVEL)
